create_MMCIFTransformer_dataset: create an MMCIFTransformer PyTorch Dataset from mmCIF pickle files for a given train, val, or test split
load_MMCIFTransformer_item: load a single protein sample with negative samples from the MMCIFTransformer dataset by index

collate_fn_transformer_test_batch: collate test data with ground truth chis and residue info into padded batch tensors for evaluation
